goal: Prevent untrusted inputs such as rejected RPC calls from injecting fake lines into debug.log
Protects node operators and automated monitoring systems from forged errors and misleading diagnostics
agreement: Strong support with all earlier objections resolved
Favors central newline escaping to also protect against daemon injection paths (davidgumberg, ryanofsky)
Verified prevention of RPC and wallet name log injection through manual testing (polespinasa)
Earlier concern that escaping newlines breaks multiline logs was settled by line splitting (maflcko)
Objection to out-of-scope wallet validation was settled by dropping those commits (ryanofsky)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because unescaped newlines allow restricted callers or daemons to forge critical error lines
Node operators and automated monitoring tools avoid false alarms from fabricated log entries
